dataset_name: APTOS 2019 Blindness Detection — Hybrid SVM vs VQC on held-out features (N=400, 5-fold, seed=42)
note: VQC is class-weighted, 50 epochs, lr=0.05, threshold 0.35. SVM is slightly stronger and more stable. No quantum advantage is claimed; VQC does not beat SVM. Decision support research tool, not a diagnostic device.
